Create a diversion of attention from itself and its continued misdeeds... By confabulating enough believable evidence... To convince passionate adepts like yourself that it really could be true.
entries.speaker: Michael Kritschgau

entries.text: And just by chance, you run into agent Scully?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ scoffs ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: I was just like you, agent Mulder: suspicious of everything but what you should be. I ran the d.o.d.'s agitprop arm for a decade. I can show you records of disinformation... Dating back to the korean war, before you were born.
entries.speaker: Michael Kritschgau

entries.text: Why come to me now? Why not four years ago?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I have a son who's very sick. He served in the gulf war. The lies are so deep, the only way to cover them... Is to create something even more incredible. They invented you: your regression hypnosis, the story of your sister's abduction, the lies they fed your father. You wanted to believe so badly, and who could have blamed you?
entries.speaker: Michael Kritschgau

entries.text: And the thousands of UFO sightings?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Above-top-secret military aircraft... Concept designed to feed hysteria.
entries.speaker: Michael Kritschgau

entries.text: Evidence of alien biology?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Unclassified but naturally occurring biologic anomalies... Science will eventually explain.
entries.speaker: Michael Kritschgau

entries.text: The body that was found?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Meticulously constructed... Out of biomaterials... Created through the hybridization of differentiated cells-- what are called chimeras-- frozen into place over the course of a year... Using sediment and materials that would bear out its age, poured through a small channel drilled in the rock above.
entries.speaker: Michael Kritschgau

entries.text: They would have known the body would be carbon-dated, that it would be proved a fake.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: The body will never be tested.
entries.speaker: Michael Kritschgau

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You were only meant to see it... To make you believe the lie... So that you might finally commit... And go public with the news.
entries.speaker: Michael Kritschgau

entries.text: This man is a liar.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You can see for yourself, agent Mulder. The body is already long gone.
entries.speaker: Michael Kritschgau

entries.text: Dr. Arlinski? It's gone.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ Mulder groans ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: What?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: It's Arlinski. He's dead.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: So is this man. Who did this, Mulder? Mulder?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What we had here was proof. There's no way it could be anything else.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You said it yourself: more tests needed to be run.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: But the ice core samples checked out. If the ice hasn't been tampered with, how could the body within be a fake?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Cellular material found in the ice core samples... Were a direct match for what this man Kritschgau described: hybrid cells, chimeras within the matrix.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Do we know for sure those cells are not extraterrestrial?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, everything this man described-- you can't just guess at these details. I'm sorry, but the facts here completely overwhelm any argument against them.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Facts overwhelmed by the lies created to support them.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: The only lie here is the one that you continue to believe.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: After all I've seen and experienced, I refuse to believe that it's not true.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Because it's easier to believe the lie, isn't it?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What the hell did that guy say to you that you believe his story?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: He said that the men behind this hoax... Behind these lies... Gave me this disease to make you believe.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: What we generally mean is intelligent life, something resembling our noble selves. It is highly probable... That there are such intelligent forms of life... In other galaxies in the universe, and it is even more probable... That many of these forms are vastly more intelligent than we.
entries.speaker: Ashley Montagu

entries.text: I think there's no question... But that we live in an inhabited universe... That has life all over it.
entries.speaker: Another Man On Video

entries.text: By finding out what the other planets are like, by finding out whether there are civilizations on planets of other stars, we reestablish a meaningful context for ourselves.
entries.speaker: Carl Sagan

entries.text: I don't think we should wait until the encounter occurs, but that we should do all in our power to prepare ourselves for it.
entries.speaker: Ashley Montagu

entries.text: I can conceive of no nightmare as terrifying... As establishing such communication... With a so-called superior... Or, if you wish, advanced technology in outer space.
entries.speaker: Isaac Asimov

entries.text: Early this morning... I got a call from the police, asking me to come to agent Mulder's apartment. The detective asked me-- he needed me to identify a body.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Agent Scully--
entries.speaker: Scott Blevins

entries.text: Agent Mulder died late last night... From an apparent self-inflicted gunshot wound to the head.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
